[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
John Taylor was appointed administrator of John Glasgow’s estate on 31 March 1789. In his 26 March certificate Peter Glasgow called Taylor his sister’s son. This states Taylor’s nephew relationship to Peter; his office alone does not establish any other kinship.<ref>Chester County Register of Wills, original file 4015, West Nottingham, 1789, volume 03901–4050, portal pp. 1060–1066; Peter’s certificate p. 1065. [https://portal.laserfiche.com/Portal/DocView.aspx?id=772934&page=1065&repo=r-24f48cc6 Official original]. Images inspected 23 October 2026.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
Profile identity remains unresolved. No father, mother or exact birth/death date is supplied by the inspected estate.
